news.title: My CEO story: Stephen Hodges, Efekta Education
news.summary_en: The PIE sat down with Stephen Hodges, CEO of Efekta Education. We spoke about his background in computer science, the pivot into education and where he sees the future of language learning.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: US science funding barred for Chinese partnerships
news.summary_en: The US National Science Foundation (NSF) will prohibit funding for US institutions collaborating with Chinese universities and other entities on the government’s restricted parties list.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Irish unis rethink recruitment as Indian students become more outcome-focused
news.summary_en: With competition for Indian students intensifying globally, Irish universities say long-term success will depend less on recruitment and more on offering employability, strong student support and lasting partnerships.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: Student storytellers and creator schemes gain ground in higher education marketing
news.summary_en: As Gen Z and Gen Alpha tune out traditional ads and polished brand messaging, universities and global test providers are turning to student creators, digital ambassadors and peer storytelling to build trust.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Trump probes Harvard’s financial aid over alleged China ties
news.summary_en: The Trump administration has launched a fresh investigation into Harvard University, alleging some of its financial aid programs favour students from China over domestic students.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Long read: Finding international student scholarships in the US – and when to look elsewhere
news.summary_en: As more affordable study destinations emerge as quality education hubs, students are increasingly questioning the ROI of an American degree. Evan Bourtis explores financial aid options for international students in the US.
news.author: Evan Bourtis

news.title: New UK education secretary amid Burnham’s first cabinet reshuffle
news.summary_en: Lucy Powell has ousted Bridget Phillipson as the UK's education secretary just hours into Andy Burnham's premiership.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: UK led the world in study visa issuance in 2025 despite woes
news.summary_en: The PIE's analysis shows that the UK issued more new study visas in 2025 than any other country in the world, despite a spike in visa refusals in Q4.
news.author: Nicholas Cuthbert and Dave Amor

news.title: Nepalese education consultancies protest sweeping new regulations
news.summary_en: Nepal's education consultancy sector has launched nationwide protests against sweeping new regulations, warning they could force smaller agencies to close and make overseas study less accessible as discussions over proposed amendments get under way.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: UK sector sets out wishlist as Andy Burnham takes No. 10
news.summary_en: UK international education stakeholders have urged the UK's new Prime Minister to maintain the Graduate Route, scrap the controversial levy on private school fees, and strengthen ties with key sending markets.
news.author: Beth Kennedy
